tasks.label: Fjernsyn: run (dev, log to /tmp/freetube-dev.log)
tasks.detail: Renderer console forwarded to the terminal and captured to a file another session can tail

tasks.label: Fjernsyn: run (dev, ordinary use, appending daily log)
tasks.detail: For collecting what the recovery ladder actually does in real viewing. Appends to thoughts/logs/ordinary-use/<date>.log so an evening across several launches is one file. Never set FT_SABR_WALL for these runs: the point is what YouTube does unprovoked.
tasks.command: mkdir -p thoughts/logs/ordinary-use && unset FT_SABR_WALL && pnpm dev 2>&1 | tee -a "thoughts/logs/ordinary-use/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).log"
